content: Friendship is the purest love. It is the highest form of love where nothing is asked for, no condition, where one simply enjoys giving.
author: Osho
sourceWork: Courage: The Joy of Living Dangerously
story:
At its core, this reflection cuts through our everyday excuses. Most human unhappiness exists in two places that don't currently exist: the past, which cannot be changed, and the future, which hasn't happened yet. Meanwhile, the only life you will ever experience is slipping past unnoticed.

Osho understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. Presence is not a rare mystical achievement; it is simply having the courtesy to show up for your own life. When you anchor your awareness in the immediate room and task, the frantic anxieties of the ego dissolve.
reflectionPrompt: How can you extend greater compassion to yourself for your own imperfections right now?
